Identity verification requires a valid government-issued photo ID and proof of address dated within the last 3 months.

For a service outage affecting all users, support must notify the on-call engineer immediately. Record the incident start time and affected services in the incident tracker.
During an active service outage, the incident coordinator posts status updates every 30 minutes. Support should direct users to the status page for progress updates.
